title: Xtra Power Diamond Saw Blade Super Thin Turbo, 110 mm, 20 mm Arbor Hole, Pack of 5
description: The Xtra Power Diamond Saw Blade Super Thin Turbo is a high-performance cutting tool designed for precision and efficiency. With a 110 mm blade diameter and a 20 mm arbor hole, this saw blade is compatible with a wide range of angle grinders and cutting machines, making it a versatile addition to any toolkit. The super thin turbo design ensures faster, cleaner cuts with minimal material wastage, while the diamond-tipped edge delivers exceptional durability and cutting power across various hard materials including tiles, granite, marble, and concrete. The turbo segment design enhances cooling and debris removal during cutting, reducing the risk of overheating and extending the blade's working life. This pack of 5 blades offers excellent value, ensuring you always have a reliable blade on hand for your projects. Ideal for both professional tradespeople and serious DIY enthusiasts, these blades are built to handle demanding cutting tasks with consistent performance. Always use appropriate safety gear when operating cutting tools.
